statements.status_notes: Nessie FIPS variants bundle Bouncy Castle bc-fips 2.1.2 (BCFIPS_VERSION via image/.bouncycastle.inc.yaml). No upstream fix is available: the GHSA advisory (GHSA-mx76-r943-rf8g) records first_patched_version as null and Maven Central currently publishes no release beyond 2.1.2. The flaw is in the AVX-widened GCM pipelines (gcm128w/gcm512w) on x86_64 hosts and impacts availability only (CVSS AV:L). Remediation requires upstream Bouncy Castle to ship a patched 2.x release. Nessie non-FIPS variants do not include bc-fips and are not affected.

CVE-2026-8149 affects Bouncy Castle BC-FJA BC-FIPS 2.1.0 through 2.1.2 on Linux X86_64 with AVX/AVX-512f. The vulnerability is associated with GCM cipher implementations (gcm128w, gcm512w). No upstream fix is available yet for the 2.1.x line. The practical impact is limited to specific hardware configurations with AVX-512f support. This CVE is under investigation pending upstream release of a patched version.
